evidence: The paper states: "The prediction explainability per model was computed via the Shapley values. This is a model-agnostic explainable artificial intelligence approach based on the cooperative game theory for feature contribution estimation" and reports findings using Global Absolute Shapley values rather than impurity-based importance from random forests. Conclusions center on cross-validated predictive performance (cROC AUC differences), not on variable importance magnitude or ranking, avoiding reliance on impurity importance entirely.
